draft.subject: When the payer asks for your notes
draft.body:
Cassius,

Most denials happen weeks after the session. The payer reviews the note, decides the documentation doesn't support the code, and claws back payment.

JotPsych checks every note against 150+ payer rules before you submit it. It flags audit risk in real time and surfaces the CPT and ICD codes your documentation actually supports.

You tried JotPsych once. If documentation risk or denials are still a problem, it's worth another look. Works with any EHR you're using now—no migration, up in 5 minutes. Or replace the whole system when you're ready.

Log back in, or let me know if you want a walkthrough of JotAudit specifically.

Best,
[Name]
JotPsych

--
